motion.purpose: Hover and press feedback on controls.

motion.name: reduced
motion.value: all transitions 0.01ms, orbit and shimmer off

display.purpose: Hero headline only; short enough to balance.

dos: Do keep one primary action per view in Instrument Teal.
Do let flat cards and hairlines separate content; reach for spacing before decoration.
Do set measurements, counts, and identifiers in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do honor reduced-motion: view fades, orbit, and shimmer all switch off under the media query.
Do write empty states as plain guidance.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glows, or glassmorphism to any surface.
Don't use amber for anything except suspect/warn states.
Don't set body copy in gray lighter than Faint Ink (#5c6160).
Don't lift, scale, or tilt cards on hover; borders may darken.
Don't put kickers or eyebrows above headlines, or all-caps microcopy anywhere.
Don't use emoji as icons or purple/indigo anywhere in the UI.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces separated by 1px hairlines; zero box-shadows.
One accent (Instrument Teal); amber appears only for suspect/warn.
Editorial display type (Archivo 800) over a system-ui body.
Mono is reserved for measurements and data, never decoration.
Motion is functional: 160ms view fades, one slow orbit, full reduced-motion support.
narrative.overview: The interface reads as one honest instrument: a flat lab bench in warm gray, near-black type, and a single deep-teal accent that marks the one action that matters per view. The hero lets the artifact lead — the real 3D assembly orbiting beside a spec sheet of computed project figures — and the app shell stays out of the way with quiet cards, hairlines, and pill navigation. Nothing glows, nothing lifts, nothing pretends: restraint is the brand, because the product's promise is that every number traces to evidence.

rules.body: Amber (#b45309) appears only for the 3D suspect highlight and warn-grade findings. It is never a button, link, or decoration.
rules.name: The Amber Reserve Rule

rules.body: Instrument Teal marks the single primary action per view. If two teal buttons appear side by side, one is wrong.
rules.name: The One Voice Rule

rules.body: Monospace appears only where a value is measured, counted, or identified. Never for kickers, buttons, or mood.
rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule

rules.body: Display headlines stay short enough to balance on two lines; the hero headline is six words.
rules.name: The Short Display Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and stay flat on hover. No element gains a shadow in any state.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
